incident-bot: [AUTO-PAGE] PagerDuty: P1 - rate-limiter anomaly detected - multiple tenants receiving 429s - paging oncall

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #INC-20240305-9876 triggered. Escalation policy: core-oncall. First page sent to Tony L.

Sara M: seeing a huge 429 spike for /v1/generate starting ~1715009760, confirmed in prod-grafana: <https://grafana.redwood/graphs/abc123|grafana link>

Tony L: on it. which service? quota-mapper or limiter?

Maria K: traces show limiter returning 429 with body: "quota exceeded: tenant=acme-corp, bucket=gen". But quota-mapper logs show a lot of 5xx timeouts to redis around the same time.

Ben P: heatmap of tenants impacted looks concentrated on a handful of heavy tenants + some synthetic traffic. rough numbers: ~8% of requests 429 for 1h, peak 25% for specific tenants.

Tony L: paging into pagerduty didn't escalate properly - I got page but ack didn't clear the autopager-dedup; seeing duplicate pages. looks like webhook retries. acking now.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by Tony L.

Sara M: quick mitigation idea: flip ff:quota-enforce -> false for "global" so limiter stops enforcing new misapplied quotas, fallback to soft cap. that should reduce consumer 429s while we fix mapper. anyone opposed?

Maria K: agree. but need to be careful for true overuse tenants. we'll add short whitelist for known noisy tenants.

Tony L: doing a controlled flip now. command: 
```\nff-cli set quota-enforce false --env=prod --reason "emergency: quota-mapper returning stale rules"\n```

Ben P: confirmed toggle applied (replication across regions still pending 20s). watching requests.

Sara M: after ff flip, 429 rate dropped to ~2% overall, noisy tenants down from 25%->6%. good signal.

ops-rotation: noted for tracking. please add incident timeline and customer impact in the ticket.

Maria K: root cause hypothesis: quota-mapper restarted due to config reload bug; it loaded an empty/legacy policy set and started returning zero allowances for some buckets. limiter treated that as hard deny. we saw errors in mapper logs: 
```\nERROR quota-mapper: failed to fetch policy: timeout talking to config-service
stack: ...\n```

Tony L: can we restart quota-mapper to pick up correct policies? we'll need a safe rollout; restart one region at a time and verify.

Ben P: I'll coordinate restart. planning rolling restart in us-east-1 then us-west-2.

Tony L: restarting quota-mapper us-east-1 now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/quota-mapper -n inference-us-east`

Ben P: pod came up healthy. config-service responded. running quick smoke: allowed quotas appear correct again.

Sara M: after restart, 429s for affected tenants dropped to baseline ~0.3%. Looks stable for 10m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident #INC-20240305-9876 status changed to RESOLVED by Tony L.

Tony L: hold on - PD shows resolved but autopager still fired a follow-up page to ops rotation due to duplicated webhook retries earlier — suppressing manual paging for next 30m.

Maria K: add follow-ups: 1) fix mapper config reload race, 2) add healthcheck to prevent empty policy publish, 3) add metric to detect sudden policy set shrink (alert before autopage).

Ben P: filing a post-incident ticket: INF-4532 - "quota-mapper: stale/empty policy publish on reload" with steps and perf logs. assigning to eng-ml infra.

Sara M: customer impact summary for CS: affected ~12 tenants intermittently over 60m, percent requests throttled at peak ~25% for top 3 tenants, estimated customer-impact window 1715009700->1715011200 UTC. add link to customer-facing incident note once we draft.

ops-rotation: handing off to next oncall (Maria K) for monitoring until 1715016100 UTC. Maria, can you take over the watch and post a short update after 30m? :thumbsup:

Maria K: taking over. I'll verify no regressions across regions and confirm rollout items tomorrow.

Tony L: final checklist: postmortem draft, alert tuning, ff revert to true after we deploy mapper fix and new healthchecks, add canary for quota publishes. closing thread once postmortem created.

Sara M: thanks all. adding timeline + links to INF-4532 now. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Note: There were 3 duplicate pages due to webhook retry and PD webhook dedupe mismatch; recommend review of PD connector.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed by Tony L at 1715012500.
